title: Local AI

card.share: {percent} % of the agents' tokens stayed local ({days} days)

classesDescription: Local AI never replaces a configured model: where it is on, it is tried first, and the configured model answers whenever it is off, down, too slow or wrong. A kind of work can be switched on once its evaluation passed.

eval.started: The evaluation runs in the background and takes a few minutes; its result shows up here.

servers.title: Model servers
servers.description: Lemonade on this machine (GPU and NPU) or another OpenAI-compatible server. Its models appear in every model picker while local AI is on.
servers.none: No server yet. Install local AI with native/local-ai/install.sh, then add it here.
servers.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? Agents fall back to their configured models.
servers.name: Name

presets.title: Preset
presets.description: Switches the kinds of work at once, as far as their evaluations passed.
presets.sparsamHint: Everything that passed its evaluation runs locally first; saves the most subscription limit.
presets.ausgewogenHint: Embeddings, Hermes' helper calls, summaries, triage and transcription locally; agents' real work stays on the configured models.
presets.qualitaetHint: Only embeddings and transcription locally; everything else on the configured models.
presets.eigeneHint: The kinds of work as set below.

embeddings.label: Embeddings (search)
embeddings.description: Vectors for semantic search in the knowledge base; while the server is down, search answers from full text.

hermes-helpers.label: Hermes helper calls
hermes-helpers.description: Context compression and image descriptions; the agent's main model answers when the local one fails.

summaries.label: Summaries and digests
summaries.description: The update digests (what a new version changes) are written by the local model; when the server does not answer, by the configured model.

triage.label: Triage and routing
triage.description: Covered by Decisions (classifying mail, choosing the model, the workflow step “Decision”); nothing else is wired here.

transcription.label: Transcription (dictation)
transcription.description: Speech to text for dictation and the conversation mode (Whisper on this machine).

speech.label: Reading aloud (voice)
speech.description: Text to speech for the conversation mode: answers read aloud by a local voice. Switch it on once the voice speaks your language (Kokoro speaks no German).

routines.label: Routine agents
routines.description: The run a routine starts tries the local model first, with the agent's configured model as the fallback. The agent acts with all of its tools.

reflection.label: Reflection after runs
reflection.description: The look back after a run (memory and skills) on the local model when the session is small enough; otherwise on the run's model.

coordinator-triage.label: Coordinator's first plan
coordinator-triage.description: An agent team's first plan (who does what); if it is unusable, the coordinator's configured model plans again.

decisions.label: Decisions
decisions.description: Typed decisions by logit readout: sorting mail, model choice, receipts, the workflow step. The kinds are switched on under Decisions.

voice-reply.label: Voice reply (fast)
voice-reply.description: In a conversation, a fast local model answers what the conversation itself answers (a greeting, “can you hear me?”, the time, “say that shorter”) in a fraction of a second; anything that needs your data or an action goes to the agent at once. It never acts itself.

updates.label: Local AI
updates.hint: Update through native/local-ai/install.sh, then evaluate again.

problems.evalFailedDetail: {model} – the configured model answers until an eval passes

voice.title: Voice in the chat
voice.failed: The voice settings could not be loaded.

pause.title: Pause before the answer
pause.hint: How long you have to be silent before Helena sends your sentence. Shorter answers faster, longer interrupts you less often.

words.title: Words Helena should know
words.hint: Names, products and terms, so speech recognition spells them right. It already knows: {words}.

voice.title: Voice
voice.hint: The local voice Helena answers with in a conversation (Local AI → “Read aloud”).
voice.none: No local voice set up yet – until then the browser reads aloud.

model.title: Model for conversations
model.hint: What your agents answer spoken turns with. A fast model with little thinking keeps the conversation flowing; agents that do not offer it answer as usual.

speed.title: Speaking rate
speed.hint: How fast the voice reads. The local voice speaks at its own pace; this applies to the browser voice.
